summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, then invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotation function, opcode/constant table, character-substitution decoder). Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is referenced by dist/ or src/, which contain an unrelated TypeScript React grid library. Installing the package causes an alien runtime to execute an opaque bundle at install time, bypassing Node-based inspection; the executed code is not auditable and is unrelated to the advertised React grid functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
